description: This Java source file contains integration tests for installment-level delinquency features in a loan management system. It defines multiple test cases to verify the behavior of delinquency bucket configurations, loan application and approval, repayment schedules, delinquency calculations, and configuration toggles related to installment-level delinquency. The class extends a base test class and uses various helpers to create clients, loans, and delinquency buckets, then asserts expected delinquency and repayment behaviors under different scenarios.

classes.name: InstallmentLevelDelinquencyAPIIntegrationTests
classes.description: Integration test suite for verifying installment-level delinquency features within the loan management system. It includes multiple test cases for different configurations and scenarios related to delinquency bucket setup, toggling installment-level delinquency, inheritance of settings, and system behavior upon COB (Close of Business) execution, ensuring robustness of delinquency calculations and configurations.

classes.name: DelinquencyData
classes.description: Helper data class capturing an individual delinquency range's minimum age days, maximum age days, and delinquent amount for comparison assertions.

methods.name: delinquency
methods.description: Factory method to create a DelinquencyData object representing a delinquency range with specified minAgeDays, maxAgeDays, and delinquentAmount.

methods.name: verifyDelinquency
methods.description: Asserts that the loan's delinquency details and installment delinquency ranges match expected values, including delinquent days, amounts, and age ranges of delinquent installments.

methods.name: updateBusinessDateAndExecuteCOBJob
methods.description: Updates the business date to a specified date and executes the COB (Close of Business) job to trigger system updates related to overdue calculations.
